data: Amazon's net sales were $574.8 billion in fiscal 2023 and $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024. For fiscal 2025, my best recollection is roughly $717 billion, which would be about a 24.7% increase over fiscal 2023. I'm not fully certain of that fiscal 2025 total, though, because it's based on summing the quarterly figures I recall and I may not have the final full-year number right. Please check it against Amazon's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K or Q4 2025 earnings release before relying on it.
